# Planora 1.7.3
## 中文 - 修复旧数据库中重复的 ManageBac 课程、Unit、教师、消息和课程表标识导致导入崩溃的问题。保留旧记录，不自动删除用户数据。 - 导入直接读取数据库，避免界面查询尚未刷新时重复插入任务；数据库读取失败时停止导入。 - 数据库明确保存到 Application Support/Planora/Planora.store。首次启动通过 SQLite 一致性备份迁移原 default.store，包括已提交的 WAL 数据，并保留原库。 - 主窗口与设置共用数据容器。打开数据失败时显示中英文错误界面，不清空数据。 - Mac 通知与头像使用统一尺寸的工具栏组，去掉头像重复底框；周历保持七列，内容宽度不足 820 点时才改为纵向，标题与周/月选择左对齐。 - Mac 更新归档和清单已签名；本次不提供 DMG。应用未经 Developer ID 公证。
## English - Prevent import crashes caused by duplicate ManageBac course, unit, teacher, message and timetable identifiers. Existing records are retained rather than automatically deleted. - Fetch existing tasks directly from the database to avoid duplicate insertion from stale UI queries. Stop imports when database reads fail. - Store data explicitly in Application Support/Planora/Planora.store. Migrate the legacy default.store using a consistent SQLite backup, including committed WAL data, while retaining the original store. - Share one data container between the main window and Settings. Show a localized recovery screen instead of clearing data if opening the store fails. - Keep notifications and profile in a consistently sized Mac toolbar group without a second avatar background. Keep seven calendar columns until content width falls below 820 points, with a left-aligned calendar heading and week/month selector. - Signed Mac update archive and feed; no DMG in this release. The app is not Developer ID notarized.
## Validation / 验证范围 - Mac: copied legacy store migration and two repeated imports passed; fresh-store and duplicate-key regressions passed (3 tests). - iPhone: 57 integration, persistence and ordering tests passed on iOS 27 Simulator. - Universal Mac Release build passed (Apple silicon and Intel). - macOS 26 runtime and final toolbar appearance still require device verification. Screenshot capture was unavailable on the development machine. - Per request, online update installation is left for the user to verify. - Mac 旧库副本迁移及连续导入、新库导入和重复键回归通过；iPhone 模拟器 57 项测试通过；Mac 双架构编译通过。 - macOS 26 实机运行及工具栏最终外观仍待验证。本机截图服务不可用，在线更新安装按要求由用户验收。

# Planora 1.7.2
## 中文 - Mac 新增检查更新、自动检查和可选自动下载；更新包与更新清单启用签名验证。 - 更新框架仅用于 Mac，iPhone 构建不再解析或下载 Sparkle。 - 首页增加周历，支持上一周、下一周、选择日期和周/月切换；日历位于成绩上方。 - 即将到来的任务不再重复当前重点，成绩默认展示三项并支持展开。 - 修复 ManageBac Completed 分组中尚未评分任务的完成状态漏读。 - DMG 提供拖放安装示意背景和中英文安装说明，不修改应用图标。
首次升级：1.7.1 及以前的版本没有更新器，需要手动安装本版一次。 Mac 要求 macOS 26 或更新版本。本版没有 Apple Developer ID 公证。 更新归档的 Ed25519 签名不等同于 Apple 公证。请阅读 DMG 安装说明。
## English - Mac-only software updates with signed feeds and archives, automatic checks and optional automatic downloads. - iPhone builds no longer resolve or download Sparkle. - Home weekly calendar with week navigation, date selection and a month toggle, above grades. - Remove duplicate focus tasks from upcoming items; expand the three-result preview on demand. - Recognize ungraded tasks within ManageBac's Completed section. - Drag-to-install DMG with bilingual instructions and preserved app icons.
Versions 1.7.1 and earlier need one manual installation to gain the updater. Requires macOS 26 or later. This build is not Apple Developer ID notarized.
